description: The signed node certificate and the service identity the agent pins from now on.

ca_certificate_pem.description: The internal CA; must match the bootstrap `ca_sha256`.
ca_certificate_pem.title: Ca Certificate Pem

certificate_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, ending in Z.
certificate_expires_at.title: Certificate Expires At

fleet_epoch.description: Fleet epoch. A restore of the control service bumps it. An agent remembers the highest epoch it accepted and refuses desired state and commands from an older one (a resurrected old control server).
fleet_epoch.title: Fleet Epoch

fleet_id.description: Fleet identifier: a lowercase UUID fixed when the fleet is created.
fleet_id.title: Fleet Id

node_id.description: Node identifier: the server's lowercase topology ID, unique within the fleet.
node_id.title: Node Id

service_certificate_pem.description: Certificate of the service signing key that signs desired state and commands: issued by the CA, with URI SAN `meridian-service://<fleet_id>`. The agent accepts no other certificate as the service's, so a node certificate can never sign desired state.
service_certificate_pem.title: Service Certificate Pem
